hadith:
Under Duress - Narrated by Abi Huraira -  Volume 9, Book 85, Number 73 

The Prophet used to invoke Allah in his prayer, "O Allah! Save 'Aiyash bin Abi Rabi'a and Salama bin Hisham and Al-Walid bin Al-Walid; O Allah! Save the weak among the believers; O Allah! Be hard upon the tribe of Mudar and inflict years (of famine) upon them like the (famine) years of Joseph."
message: In the Name of Allah—the Most Beneficent, Most Merciful
name:
Al Jaleel - الْجَلِيلُ - The Majestic

The name Al Jaleel emphasizes Allah's majesty and grandeur, reflecting His supreme authority and the awe-inspiring nature of His creation. It reminds believers of the reverence due to Allah and the beauty in His divine attributes. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'jalal', which relates to honor and magnificence.
verse:
Al-Humazah - The Traducer - 104:1-3

Woe to every backbiter, slanderer, who amasses wealth ˹greedily˺ and counts it ˹repeatedly˺, thinking that their wealth will make them immortal!
